title: U.S. House · Texas's 24th Congressional District
area: North Texas suburbs of Dallas-Fort Worth, including Irving, Coppell, and parts of Denton, Tarrant, and Collin counties.

context.text: Texas redrew its congressional district boundaries in August 2025 ahead of the 2026 elections, a mid-decade redistricting.
In the May 26, 2026 Democratic primary runoff, Kevin Burge defeated TJ Ware, 78.1% to 21.9%, to advance to the general election.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Small Business (Chairman, Economic Growth, Tax, and Capital Access subcommittee) and the House Committee on Ways and Means (Oversight, Tax, Trade, and Work and Welfare subcommittees) in the 119th Congress.

candidates.name: Kevin Burge
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 26, 2026 Democratic primary runoff with 78.1% of the vote

priorities.text: In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, named affordability as the district's main challenge, citing housing, healthcare, childcare, and utility and insurance costs.
Said he would work in Congress to roll back tariffs, expand grants for technical skills training, and fund universal pre-K.
Listed foreign policy priorities of strong global alliances, restoring congressional war authority, and congressional oversight of trade and military action.

positions.summary: Says he would work to roll back tariffs imposed under the Trump administration, citing their inflationary effects.
positions.quote: I'll work to roll back Trump's Tariffs and their inflationary effects

positions.summary: Campaign issues page lists expanding ACA tax credits and Medicaid expansion and passing universal health coverage.
positions.quote: Expand Affordable Care Act (ACA) tax credits to lower costs

positions.summary: Campaign issues page says he will fight to codify Roe v. Wade into federal law.
positions.quote: Fight to codify Roe v. Wade into Federal Law

positions.summary: Campaign issues page says he will vote to raise the federal minimum wage.
positions.quote: Vote to raise the federal minimum wage

positions.summary: In his Ballotpedia survey he lists congressional war authority among his foreign policy priorities and says Congress has ceded power over military action.
positions.quote: Foreign Policy: Strong Global Alliances, Congressional War Authority, Canceling Blanket Tariffs, Congressional Oversight
